description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs: Several identifiers in doc comments (KeyUsage, SubjectPublicKeyInfo, NameConstraints, rustcrypto, etc.) are not wrapped in backticks. These fire under clippy::pedantic (doc_markdown lint) but not under the default -D warnings set. Fix if the project adds -W clippy::pedantic to CI.
title: doc_markdown pedantic: identifiers not backtick-quoted in pkix-path doc comments
